input.quote: The Parties recognize and agree that the PG does not make any representations or warranties, including, but not limited to, any representation or warranty regarding:
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no express performance or conformance warranty anywhere. The only warranty language is a disclaimer: Paragraph 4.9 (p0126) states the PG "does not make any representations or warranties" regarding (i) Supplier performance of the Supply Contract, (ii) the performance or reliability of the Wet Segment, or (iii) integration into operation, and p0127 adds that "nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as such a warranty or guarantee." Paragraphs 4.6-4.8 (p0122-p0125) only oblige the PG to procure certain Supply Contract terms and permit the PG to pursue the Supplier; they give the Parties no warranty and no remedy, and 4.9 expressly negates PG liability for non-conformance. Paragraph 10.1-10.2 (p0169-p0171) is a reasonable-efforts maintenance covenant, not a conformance warranty with remedies. That combination is the walk-away position (no conformance warranty at all), so it fails the fallback on every element. We therefore target the fallback: a 90-day conformance warranty for the Wet Segment and its software against documentation and Supply Contract specifications, a 30-day services warranty, and repair/replacement or refund remedies, with a matching carve-out from the 4.9/p0127 disclaimer so the disclaimer does not swallow the new warranty. Paragraph 25 (p0260) already carries a mutual compliance-with-law covenant, which is a preferred-level element only and is not required at the fallback we selected.

proposal.summary: Add a 90-day conformance warranty for the Wet Segment and its software, a 30-day services warranty, and repair/replacement or refund remedies, and carve them out of the Paragraph 4.9 disclaimer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 4.9 currently disclaims every warranty as to the Wet Segment and Supplier performance, which is our walk-away position, so we have added a short fallback conformance warranty (90 days for the Wet Segment and its software against its documentation, 30 days for services) with repair, replacement or refund as the remedy. We have carved that warranty out of the existing disclaimer so the two provisions do not contradict each other.

ops.oldText: and the Parties hereby agree that nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as such a warranty or guarantee.
ops.newText: and the Parties hereby agree that, except as provided in Paragraph 4.10, nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as such a warranty or guarantee.

ops.text: The PG warrants that (a) for a period of ninety (90) days following the RFPA Date, the Wet Segment and any software delivered with it will conform to its documentation and to the technical specifications and other requirements of the Supply Contract, and (b) for a period of thirty (30) days following their performance, services performed by the PG under this Paragraph 4 will conform to the requirements of this Agreement. For breach of this warranty the PG shall, as the affected Party elects, repair or replace the non-conforming Wet Segment, software or services, or refund the amounts paid by that Party in respect of the non-conforming item.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
